description: This file defines the ExtendedJpaTransactionManager class, which extends Spring's JpaTransactionManager to add custom transaction lifecycle callbacks and read-only transaction handling.

classes.name: ExtendedJpaTransactionManager
classes.description: A custom transaction manager extending JpaTransactionManager with additional lifecycle callbacks and read-only transaction handling.

methods.name: ExtendedJpaTransactionManager
methods.description: Constructor that enables validation of existing transactions.

methods.name: doBegin
methods.description: Begins a transaction, setting flush mode to COMMIT if read-only, and invokes afterBegin callbacks.

methods.name: doCommit
methods.description: Commits a transaction, clearing the EntityManager if read-only, and invokes afterCommit callbacks.

methods.name: isReadOnlyConnection
methods.description: Checks if the current database connection is read-only.

methods.name: doCleanupAfterCompletion
methods.description: Performs cleanup after transaction completion and invokes afterCompletion callbacks.

methods.name: isReadOnlyTx
methods.description: Determines if the given transaction is marked as read-only.

methods.name: getCurrentEntityManager
methods.description: Retrieves the current EntityManager from the transaction synchronization manager.

methods.name: setLifecycleCallbacks
methods.description: Adds provided callbacks to the lifecycle callback list.
